faculties.title: Health & Medical Sciences
faculties.tagline: Heal people. Save lives. Lead South Africa's healthcare system.
faculties.description: Careers in this field directly impact health outcomes — from medicine and nursing to psychology and pharmacy. If you care deeply about people and have a strong science background, this is your path.

faculties.title: Engineering & Infrastructure
faculties.tagline: Build the systems and structures that power our country.
faculties.description: Engineers design, build and maintain the physical world — from power grids and bridges to buildings and transport networks. Strong Mathematics and Physical Sciences are your entry point.

faculties.title: Information Technology & Data
faculties.tagline: Code. Analyse. Build the digital world of tomorrow.
faculties.description: From software engineering and cybersecurity to data science and game development — IT is the fastest-growing sector globally. If you love how systems work, this faculty is built for you.

faculties.title: Commerce & Business
faculties.tagline: Drive business. Build wealth. Lead organisations forward.
faculties.description: Commerce covers accounting, finance, marketing and entrepreneurship. If you are ambitious, love numbers and want to build or lead something that lasts, this is your faculty.

faculties.title: Creative Arts & Design
faculties.tagline: Express. Inspire. Shape culture through your creativity.
faculties.description: Creative careers in design, media, architecture and journalism are for people who see the world differently. Your creativity is not a hobby — it is a full career.

faculties.title: Natural & Applied Sciences
faculties.tagline: Research. Discover. Solve South Africa's biggest challenges.
faculties.description: Scientists research ecosystems, advance agriculture, develop medicines and unlock knowledge. If you ask deep questions and want to understand how the natural world works, science is your home.

faculties.title: Education, Law & Social Sciences
faculties.tagline: Teach. Defend rights. Transform communities from within.
faculties.description: Careers in teaching, law and social work are for people who lead with deep purpose. These professions shape communities, protect rights and build the next generation — among the most meaningful you can choose.
